_comment: Declarative Flipper SD-card loadout for fleet diagnostics. Copy to local/ and adjust. Firmware is intentionally a variable, not a choice this kit makes for you.

firmware.notes: One of: stock-ofw | unleashed | roguemaster | momentum. Affects Sub-GHz regions/protocols.
